study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: A function is a small group of instructions. I give the function a name: greet. When I call greet, it says hello. I do not write the same code many times. I write it once and use it again. This makes the program easier to read.
segments.tts: A function is a small group of instructions. I give the function a name: greet. When I call greet, it says hello. I do not write the same code many times. I write it once and use it again. This makes the program easier to read.
segments.zh: 函数是一小组指令。我给函数起名 greet。调用 greet 时，它会说 hello。我不需要把同样的代码写很多遍，只写一次，然后重复使用。这样程序更容易阅读。讲解：function=函数，instruction=指令，call a function=调用函数。

segments.en: Some functions take an input. I make a function called double. It takes a number and returns the number times two. I give it three, and it returns six. The function has one clear job. Clear jobs are easier to test.
segments.tts: Some functions take an input. I make a function called double. It takes a number and returns the number times two. I give it three, and it returns six. The function has one clear job. Clear jobs are easier to test.
segments.zh: 有些函数接收输入。我写一个叫 double 的函数，它接收一个数字，并返回这个数字乘以二。我给它三，它返回六。这个函数只有一个清楚的任务。任务清楚，测试就容易。讲解：input=输入，return=返回，times=乘以，job=任务。

segments.en: I write a short test for double. I expect double three to be six. The test passes. I feel more confident because the code has a small proof. A function and a test work well together.
segments.tts: I write a short test for double. I expect double three to be six. The test passes. I feel more confident because the code has a small proof. A function and a test work well together.
segments.zh: 我为 double 写一个小测试。我期待 double three 的结果是 six，测试通过了。有了这个小证明，我更有信心。函数和测试很适合一起工作。讲解：expect=期待，pass=通过，confident=有信心的，proof=证明。

chunks.eg: A function is a group of instructions.
Tests and functions work well together.

patterns.t: It takes X and returns Y.
patterns.cn: 它接收 X 并返回 Y。

patterns.t: I expect X to be Y.
patterns.cn: 我期待 X 是 Y。

transfer_tasks.task: Write a short code review comment about a function. Use take an input, return a value, and work well together.
